review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — DESIGN.md is new at the repo root. It has sections for colour tokens, typography, spacing and radius, elevation, breakpoints and shared components, and each section names its source files.
- A2: unverified — No source files were available, so cited names and values could not be checked against the named files. The doc is internally consistent.
- A3: met — Differences and hard-coded values are under Observations, which says "Nothing here is a request to change it". No recommendations or redesigns appear anywhere.
- A4: met — The diff adds only DESIGN.md.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- A2 needs a mechanical token check against the source files `DESIGN.md` — Before merging, run a check that extracts each `--token`: `value` pair and each quoted literal from DESIGN.md and greps for it in the file named next to it. Alternatively, a reviewer can spot-check globals.css :root and its dark block, report.css @media print, and site.css .site.
- Tokens that keep their light value in dark mode are written out instead of shown as a dash `DESIGN.md:67` — Use `–` where the dark block omits the token. If the dark block does restate it, add a note saying so.
- Exact counts and lists will go stale without a hint `DESIGN.md` — Drop the exact count, or mark these lists as a snapshot as of this change.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: A2 needs a mechanical token check against the source files
suggestions.detail: This review ran without the repository's source files, so none of the roughly 150 cited token names and values could be compared with globals.css, console.css, auth.css, join.css, group.css, report.css, site.css or the layout files. The doc is internally consistent: each print override that differs from screen is listed under Observations, and the site and console values match between sections. Consistency alone does not prove each value appears in its named file.
suggestions.repro: n/a (verification gap, not a reproduced defect)
suggestions.fix: Before merging, run a check that extracts each `--token`: `value` pair and each quoted literal from DESIGN.md and greps for it in the file named next to it. Alternatively, a reviewer can spot-check globals.css :root and its dark block, report.css @media print, and site.css .site.

suggestions.title: Tokens that keep their light value in dark mode are written out instead of shown as a dash
suggestions.detail: Line 25 says a dash means the token keeps its light value in dark mode. `--c-mid` (line 67) and `--c-series-6` (line 102) repeat the same value in the Dark column instead. A reader can't tell whether the dark block redefines them with the same value or omits them.
suggestions.repro: Compare line 25 with the `--c-mid` row (`#8a939d` | `#8a939d`) and the `--c-series-6` row (`#008300` | `#008300`).
suggestions.fix: Use `–` where the dark block omits the token. If the dark block does restate it, add a note saying so.

suggestions.title: Exact counts and lists will go stale without a hint
suggestions.detail: Several details are exact snapshots: `Icon` has "39 names", the per-file media query lists are exhaustive, and the hard-coded colour list for site.css is complete. Any UI change will make these wrong. The intro already says the code wins, but these are the parts most likely to drift.
suggestions.repro: Add one icon to Icon.tsx; DESIGN.md still says 39.
suggestions.fix: Drop the exact count, or mark these lists as a snapshot as of this change.
